summary.text: Max Carter is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 12 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is vice chair of the Growth and Infrastructure Committee.

paragraphs.text: Carter assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Susan Martinez; Ballotpedia lists him as Max Carter II.
For 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Government Affairs, and Growth and Infrastructure committees.
For 2025 and 2026 he kept those assignments and became vice chair of the Growth and Infrastructure Committee.
